notes: Preset values and estimate calibration for CFD runs (building-energy-cfd-p2-contract.md S8). Bounds, preset membership and the panel metadata are the CFD Settings Catalog: x-cfd-setting in tests/contracts/cfd-run-request-v1.schema.json, generated into cfd_settings_catalog.py (docs/architecture/cfd-settings-catalog-adr.md).
Contract bounds and the compute hard cap stay out of this file (cfd_settings_catalog.REQUEST_FIELD_BOUNDS, CFD_MAX_CELLS_PER_DIRECTION); this file never widens them.
The standard preset must reproduce the service defaults exactly; changing a value here changes the service default and needs an owner decision.

A request is matched to a preset by its values alone (preset_match), so no two presets may share values. fast_preview (settings phase C, owner decision 2026-09-30) is standard plus one outer coarsening level; its verification evidence is docs/evidence/cfd-b-s7-2026-09-24/.

description.zh: 與目前服務預設完全相同，也是 181 上 16 向 run 使用的設定。精度等級仍是 screening，只作設計比較。
description.en: Identical to the current service defaults and the settings of the 16-direction run on 181. Accuracy stays at screening: design comparison only.

description.zh: 與標準組只差外圍放粗 1 層：建物附近的格距不變，遠場放粗一倍。本機驗證（docs/evidence/cfd-b-s7-2026-09-24）：AIJ Case C 通過五項門檻，格數約 35%、耗時約 41%；實案準確度通過（峰值差 −1.2%、面積平均差 +0.06%），但格數只降到 55.7%、耗時 55.8%，未減半。精度等級仍是 screening，只作設計比較。
description.en: Standard plus one outer coarsening level: near-building spacing unchanged, far field twice as coarse. Local verification (docs/evidence/cfd-b-s7-2026-09-24): AIJ Case C passed all five thresholds at about 35% of the cells and 41% of the time; the real case passed accuracy (peak −1.2%, area mean +0.06%) but only came down to 55.7% of the cells and 55.8% of the time, not half. Accuracy stays at screening: design comparison only.
